analysis: The only change in this PR is test-only: five new expectations added to updateNoticed() in provider-swift/Tests/ClusterOnboardingChecks/OnboardingChecks.swift (head lines 1257-1262). They exercise a new helper, ClusterOnboardingUpdate.oneBuild(pinned:current:), which should return true only when both Macs report the same new worker digest. It should return false when the other Mac reports the old digest, has not answered, or was not asked, and when there is no pinned setup. The helper implementation is not in the supplied evidence, so I could not verify it. The tests cover the intended fail-safe behavior: wait rather than re-plan on a partial or unknown answer. The base text I reviewed (lines 868-1582) was unchanged context; it holds onboarding and cluster-local UI checks with no production code. This diff does not touch any threat-model asset (A-001 to A-019) or trust boundary (TB-002, TB-003, TB-007, TB-009, TB-011, TB-012, TB-013). It adds no attack surface in the cache, attestation, or coordinator WebSocket paths, and no secrets or network behavior. Integration question for any pass that sees production source: confirm that oneBuild compares digests across Macs for equality and also requires that they differ from the pinned values. The tests imply that `current` is nonempty for both pinned IDs and that the digests are equal. Also confirm that digests come from an authenticated source, since cluster peer digests are self-reported. That is outside this test-only diff and not evidenced as a regression.
